quality.review_scope: Independent scientific audit of both scanned main pages through visual reading and the accepted correction revision passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Two-page scanned main fully read visually; embedded/cache article text is unavailable. SI and cited sources remain unreviewed.
Absolute precursor masses/mmol, solvent grade, reaction pressure, ramp/cooling rates and yield are not reported.
Theoretical feed proportions are derived from the displayed equation, not fabricated absolute charges.
The wash reagent is called absolute alcohol without explicit molecular identity; no ethanol assignment is made. Wash volumes/count, drying and storage are absent.
Only the benzene product has the displayed XRD/TEM panels. Do not transfer its sizes, lattice parameter or spherical morphology to alternative solvents or controls.
No sample-measured atomic coordinates or refined site occupancy are supplied.
Precursor, apparatus and morphology illustrations remain presentation pending.
